title: The ark brought to Jerusalem
summary: David brings the ark to Jerusalem (2 Sam 6).
description: David brings the ark to Jerusalem (2 Sam 6). The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 1): 1048 BC (Ussher-Jones). Sort changed by the Reply to Beckman pass (2026-11-13): was ussher-jones 1047 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 1: Jewish Sources for the Chronology of the Divided Kingdom," OSF preprint v1.4 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/XJZBM, section “Precise Durations that Agree with Ussher’s Divided Kingdom”, item 2, p. 17
chronologies.note: The year David brought the Ark to Jerusalem, as the papers print it for Ussher-Jones. The Jones Appendix F entry stored here reads 1047; see OPEN-QUESTIONS.

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
